question: How is the group of eight identified in this part of the teaching?
premises: Kāla and Karṇātmaka are named as members.
The group of eight is declared in this context.
inference: The teaching identifies members such as Kāla and Karṇātmaka within the declared group of eight.
uncertainties: Only two members are explicitly named in this verse; the full list may be completed elsewhere.
plain_english: Thus Kāla and Karṇātmaka are named, and then the group of eight is declared.
